title: Use a short real-world clip you filmed (e.g., at Skytree) as the source and…
content:
Use a short real-world clip you filmed (e.g., at Skytree) as the source and prompt Seedance 2.0 to recreate a specific After Effects “classic” effect on it.  
Run about 2 generations/iterations to reach a usable result; expect roughly ~15 minutes total generation time for this kind of effect recreation.
